20. The crew behind the 1963 Great Train Robbery executed their heist with military precision, but their downfall was caused by a simple evening of entertainment. While hiding out at Leatherslade Farm to wait for the heat to die down, the gang became restless and decided to pass the time by playing a world-famous board game, X. In a display of extreme arrogance, they threw away the fake paper currency included in the box and used stacks of the actual stolen banknotes—totaling hundreds of thousands of pounds—as the "bank." When they eventually fled the hideout, they were meticulous, wiping every doorknob and surface for evidence, but they completely ignored the game they had left sitting on the table. What game were they playing?
